Developer's Live Stream
Hello!
We are very excited about streaming our game and we want you to join us as we play through our demo. Soulz is a strategic duel CCG with board-based deep tactical play with various cards and decks. You can beat Devs if we can meet on a match. Let’s play SOULZ!
